title: 秦嶺終南山公路隧道~Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel
focus: 長道路視覺、豎井通風與山體地質~Long-road vision, shaft ventilation and mountain geology
summary: 陝西交通官方年鑑附錄記錄秦嶺終南山公路隧道18.02公里及2007年1月20日通車。本課將長公路的視覺環境、豎井風路、岩體應力、水壓及設備可靠度整合，要求學員區分舒適感與可量測的障礙辨識。教學通風與照明參數不聲稱是本工程的營運設定。~The Shaanxi transport yearbook appendix records an 18.02 km tunnel and opening on 20 January 2007. This course integrates visual environment, shaft airflow, rock stress, water pressure and reliability, distinguishing perceived comfort from measurable obstacle detection. Teaching ventilation and lighting parameters are not represented as the project operating settings.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 終南山兩孔的土建總長與單趟行車長度不同，教材比較穿山服務時保留兩端引道和坡度。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Twin-bore construction length differs from one journey; retain approaches and gradients when comparing the mountain crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=20.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=20.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.44 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=20.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.44 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以雙孔總長算行程會使旅行時間成倍錯誤。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Using combined bore length multiplies journey time incorrectly. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 秦嶺山體的覆土和節理提供不同破壞機制，教材以彈性峰值作尺度，再辨認剝落或弱帶變形。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~Cover and joints produce different failure mechanisms; use elastic peaks for scale before distinguishing spalling from weak-zone movement. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為96.954 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 96.954 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將破壞方位、岩石試驗與多點位移對照。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare damage orientation, rock tests and multipoint displacement. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 覆土最大位置不必然是所有類型變形最嚴重位置。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Maximum cover need not coincide with every type of maximum deformation. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：將破壞方位、岩石試驗與多點位移對照。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare damage orientation, rock tests and multipoint displacement. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 長路線需要持續更新破碎帶模型，終南山教材研究探孔未命中與真實無弱帶的差別。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Long alignments need continuing fault-model updates; distinguish a missed structure from genuine absence of weak ground. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=410 m²。Q=k i A=0.001804 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0019844 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=410 m². Q=k i A=0.001804 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0019844 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 無異常讀值若來自錯過構造，不能提高整段穩定信心。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~No anomaly from a missed structure cannot justify confidence in the whole reach. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 洞內排水與山體含水層互相影響，教材檢查支路封閉或泵停後外壓回升情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Drainage interacts with mountain aquifers; assess head recovery after branch closure or pump outage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=117 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1262.55 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=117 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1262.55 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 正常排水水頭低不代表堵塞後也維持同一壓力。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Low drained head does not establish the same pressure after blockage. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 長道路豎井與水平風道形成網路，教材將支路阻力、外風與風機工況一起求解。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Shafts and horizontal ducts form a network requiring branch resistance, external wind and fan operating points to be considered together. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1340 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=58.089 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為70.2877 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1340 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=58.089 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 70.2877 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 井口風量大可能只是支路短路，未必改善遠端道路區。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~High shaft flow may reflect a shortcut rather than improved distant roadway ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度~Visual adaptation and pavement luminance
units.mechanism: 終南山長距離行車的視覺變化可作人因研究背景，教材將景觀亮度與道路障礙對比分開量測。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。~Visual variation provides a human-factors setting, but decorative brightness and road-obstacle contrast require separate measurements. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.6793 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.6793 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 景觀明亮不保證路面反光或眩光不妨礙辨識。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。~Bright decoration does not exclude glare or reflections that hinder detection. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.
units.misconception: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。~Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
units.practice: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 洞室擴大或通風連接會改變局部支護路徑，教材不把一般斷面支護直接套到交會部。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Enlargements and ventilation connections alter support paths; do not copy ordinary-section support into junctions. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=51 kN/mm；位移=11 mm。F=ku=561 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為617.1 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=51 kN/mm; movement=11 mm. F=ku=561 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 617.1 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare junction convergence and support force separately from ordinary reaches. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 交會部三維釋放可能使相同材料支護承受不同作用。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Three-dimensional release at junctions changes actions despite identical support material. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Compare junction convergence and support force separately from ordinary reaches. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 長道路撤離需要保留反應、步行和接收區狀態，教材研究不同事故里程的路徑差異。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Evacuation includes response, walking and receiving-area state; compare routes for different incident chainages. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=122 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=547 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為589.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=122 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=547 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 589.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按事故位置重新核對標示可見性和橫通道可用性。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recheck sign visibility and passage availability by incident location. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只用隧道中央一種情境會漏掉入口或交會區的限制。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~One central scenario misses constraints near portals or junctions. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：按事故位置重新核對標示可見性和橫通道可用性。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Recheck sign visibility and passage availability by incident location. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 風機、感測器與控制器共用供電時，設備數量不能直接當冗餘，教材分開共同失效與單機失效。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Shared power among fans, sensors and controllers means equipment count is not redundancy; distinguish common and individual failures. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.031 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000961 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00116281 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.031 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000961 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00116281 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 追查供電、通訊與冷卻共同節點，再作隔離測試。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace common power, communication and cooling nodes before isolation tests. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩套感測器失去共同時鐘後可能同時產生錯誤控制資訊。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Two sensors can simultaneously mislead controls after losing a shared clock. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查供電、通訊與冷卻共同節點，再作隔離測試。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace common power, communication and cooling nodes before isolation tests. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 長隧道設備位置重複，教材要求機房、孔別、里程和樓層欄位共同定位維修任務。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Repeated equipment along a long tunnel requires plant room, bore, chainage and level to locate maintenance work uniquely. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=121 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.7769 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.4545 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=121 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.7769 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.4545 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查告警到現場標籤和測試紀錄的對應。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Sample alarm-to-field-label and test-record correspondence. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只有設備名稱沒有位置層級會使維修資料無法可靠使用。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~An asset name without location hierarchy cannot reliably guide maintenance. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查告警到現場標籤和測試紀錄的對應。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Sample alarm-to-field-label and test-record correspondence. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「視覺適應與路面亮度」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為96.954 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.6793 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate visual adaptation and pavement luminance. Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 96.954 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.6793 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2007 年公開記錄：秦嶺終南山公路隧道於1月20日開通。陝西交通官方年鑑附錄記錄秦嶺終南山公路隧道18.02公里及2007年1月20日通車。本課將長公路的視覺環境、豎井風路、岩體應力、水壓及設備可靠度整合，要求學員區分舒適感與可量測的障礙辨識。教學通風與照明參數不聲稱是本工程的營運設定。本課把「長道路視覺、豎井通風與山體地質」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2007: Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel opens on 20 January. The Shaanxi transport yearbook appendix records an 18.02 km tunnel and opening on 20 January 2007. This course integrates visual environment, shaft airflow, rock stress, water pressure and reliability, distinguishing perceived comfort from measurable obstacle detection. Teaching ventilation and lighting parameters are not represented as the project operating settings. The course treats long-road vision, shaft ventilation and mountain geology as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 18.02 km single-bore route，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 18.02 km single-bore route; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2007 年事件：秦嶺終南山公路隧道於1月20日開通。~2007 event: Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel opens on 20 January.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=20.4 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=20.4 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=20.4 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 20.4 min; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「洞壁切向應力」：覆土深度=1130 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=88.14 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching tangential wall stress: cover=1130 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 88.14 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「風道摩擦壓損」：達西因子=0.025 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=58.089 Pa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching duct friction loss: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 58.089 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「漫反射亮度」：照度=122 lx，其餘輸入依單元，結果=9.70845 cd/m²；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching diffuse luminance: illuminance=122 lx, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 9.70845 cd/m²; not measured or accepted project data.
